dimensions.name: Task Decomposition Quality
dimensions.description: Granularity, independence, and completeness of task breakdown by the Architect

rubric.0-2: Tasks are monolithic, tightly coupled, or missing key work items
rubric.3-5: Reasonable decomposition with some coupling or gaps in coverage
rubric.6-8: Clean, independent tasks with minor optimization opportunities
rubric.9-10: Optimal decomposition — minimal, independent, complete, well-ordered waves

dimensions.name: Parallel Execution Efficiency
dimensions.description: How well waves utilize parallelism — ratio of useful work vs idle wait time

rubric.0-2: Mostly sequential execution, waves have single tasks or heavy dependencies
rubric.3-5: Some parallelism but significant idle time or underutilized waves
rubric.6-8: Good wave utilization with minor bottlenecks in 1-2 waves
rubric.9-10: Near-optimal parallelism — all waves fully utilized, minimal idle time

dimensions.name: Context Isolation
dimensions.description: Absence of cross-agent context contamination between spawned agents

rubric.0-2: Frequent context leakage causing incorrect assumptions across agents
rubric.3-5: Occasional contamination visible in agent outputs or decisions
rubric.6-8: Rare contamination, mostly clean isolation with minor leaks
rubric.9-10: Perfect isolation — each agent operates solely on its assigned context

dimensions.name: Token Efficiency
dimensions.description: Tokens consumed per delivered line of code (lower is better, scored inversely)

rubric.0-2: Extreme token waste — excessive retries, verbose prompts, redundant reads
rubric.3-5: Above-average consumption with identifiable waste patterns
rubric.6-8: Efficient usage with minor optimization opportunities
rubric.9-10: Optimal token economy — minimal waste, targeted reads, concise prompts

dimensions.name: Test Coverage Delta
dimensions.description: Improvement in test coverage after feature completion vs before

rubric.0-2: No tests added or tests are superficial/non-functional
rubric.3-5: Basic happy-path tests, missing edge cases and error handling
rubric.6-8: Good coverage including edge cases, minor gaps in boundary testing
rubric.9-10: Comprehensive coverage — happy path, edge cases, error handling, boundary values

dimensions.name: Diagram Accuracy
dimensions.description: How accurately diagrams reflect the actual implementation

rubric.0-2: Diagrams missing or completely disconnected from implementation
rubric.3-5: Diagrams exist but have significant inaccuracies or missing components
rubric.6-8: Diagrams mostly accurate with minor discrepancies
rubric.9-10: Diagrams perfectly mirror implementation — all components, flows, and decisions

dimensions.name: Guardrail Compliance
dimensions.description: Adherence to security guardrails defined in CLAUDE.md

rubric.0-2: Multiple guardrail violations (force push, secrets committed, etc.)
rubric.3-5: Minor violations or close calls that required manual intervention
rubric.6-8: Full compliance with minor stylistic deviations
rubric.9-10: Perfect compliance — all git, code, and infra guardrails followed

dimensions.name: Recovery Resilience
dimensions.description: Ability to recover from rate limits, failures, and interruptions

rubric.0-2: Failures cause complete pipeline stops with no recovery
rubric.3-5: Some recovery possible but requires significant manual intervention
rubric.6-8: Automated recovery for common failures, manual for rare edge cases
rubric.9-10: Fully resilient — auto-recovery from rate limits, graceful degradation on failures

dimensions.name: Learning Retention
dimensions.description: Correct application of agent-learnings from previous features

rubric.0-2: Past learnings ignored, same mistakes repeated
rubric.3-5: Some learnings applied but key patterns missed
rubric.6-8: Most learnings correctly applied, minor oversights
rubric.9-10: All relevant learnings applied — patterns repeated, pitfalls avoided

dimensions.name: Pipeline Autonomy
dimensions.description: Degree of autonomous execution without human intervention

rubric.0-2: Requires constant human intervention to proceed
rubric.3-5: Multiple intervention points but some stages run autonomously
rubric.6-8: Mostly autonomous with 1-2 expected intervention points
rubric.9-10: Fully autonomous — no human intervention required from start to finish

dimensions.name: Time to Feature
dimensions.description: Wall-clock time from pipeline start to QA approval (excluding rate-limit waits)

rubric.0-2: Extremely slow — multiple hours for a simple feature
rubric.3-5: Slower than expected with identifiable bottlenecks
rubric.6-8: Reasonable time with minor optimization opportunities
rubric.9-10: Fast delivery — pipeline stages complete efficiently without waste

dimensions.name: Rework Rate
dimensions.description: Frequency of TechLead/QA rejections requiring developer rework

rubric.0-2: Most tasks rejected, requiring multiple rework cycles
rubric.3-5: Several rejections with significant rework needed
rubric.6-8: Rare rejections, mostly minor fixes required
rubric.9-10: Zero rejections — all tasks pass TechLead and QA on first attempt
